lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala.
couplets.en: The shining moon was made a broken star.

lines: Bada dilkash, bada rangeen hai yeh shahar, kehte hain.
couplets.en: They say this city is charming and full of color.

lines: Bada dilkash, bada rangeen hai yeh shahar, kehte hain.
Yahan par hain hazaaron ghar, gharon mein log rehte hain.
couplets.en: They say this city is charming and full of color, with thousands of homes and people living in them.

lines: Mujhe is shahar ne galiyon ka banjaara bana daala.
Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala.
couplets.en: This city made me a wanderer in its lanes, a shining moon reduced to a broken star.

lines: Main is duniya ko aksar dekh kar hairaan hota hoon.
couplets.en: I often look at this world in wonder.

lines: Main is duniya ko aksar dekh kar hairaan hota hoon.
Na mujhse ban saka chhota sa ghar, din raat rota hoon.
couplets.en: I often look at this world in wonder, weeping day and night because I could never build even a small home.

lines: Khudaaya, tune kaise yeh jahaan saara bana daala?
couplets.en: My God, how did you make this whole world?

lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala.
couplets.en: The shining moon was made a broken star.

lines: Mere maalik, mera dil kyun tadapta hai, sulagta hai?
couplets.en: My Lord, why does my heart ache and smolder?

lines: Mere maalik, mera dil kyun tadapta hai, sulagta hai?
Teri marzi, teri marzi pe kiska zor chalta hai?
couplets.en: My Lord, why does my heart ache and smolder, and who can prevail against your will?

lines: Kisi ko gul, kisi ko tune angaara bana daala.
Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala.
couplets.en: You made one a rose and another a burning ember, and turned the shining moon into a broken star.

lines: Yahi aaghaaz tha mera, yahi anjaam hona tha.
couplets.en: This was my beginning, and this was how I was bound to end.

lines: Yahi aaghaaz tha mera, yahi anjaam hona tha.
couplets.en: This was my beginning, and this was how I was bound to end.

lines: Yahi aaghaaz tha mera, yahi anjaam hona tha.
Mujhe barbaad hona tha, mujhe naakaam hona tha.
couplets.en: This was my beginning, and I was bound to end in ruin, with nothing I had hoped for.

lines: Mujhe taqdeer ne taqdeer ka maara bana daala.
couplets.en: Fate made me its own casualty.

couplets.en: My restlessness made me a wanderer, a shining moon reduced to a broken star.
